title: Postcomposition comparison for raw coherent realization
statement:
Use quasicategories, weak homotopy equivalences and right-pinched mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the canonical mapping-space composition and homotopy category $hS$ of [lem-coef-infinity-mapping-composition], and coherent realization and locally Kan replacement of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison]. Let $S$ be a small quasicategory, put $D=\mathfrak C[S]$, and write $r:D\to RD$ for an object-preserving locally Kan replacement. Let $W=N_{\mathrm{hc}}(RD)$ and $a:S\to W$ be adjoint to $r$. Then $a$ is a categorical equivalence, and for every pair of vertices its map $\operatorname{Map}_S(x,y)\to\operatorname{Map}_W(ax,ay)$ is a weak homotopy equivalence. For every edge $h:y\to z$ and every vertex $w$, the composite of this map with the inverse of the locally Kan comparison $RD(w,y)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_W(aw,ay)$, interpreted in the homotopy category of spaces, carries postcomposition by $h$ to enriched postcomposition by the vertex $r([h])$. Here $[h]$ denotes the vertex of $D(y,z)$ induced by that edge.

Consequently, whenever $h\circ-:\operatorname{Map}_S(w,y)\to\operatorname{Map}_S(w,z)$ is a weak homotopy equivalence, the actual simplicial composition map $[h]\circ-:D(w,y)\to D(w,z)$ is a weak homotopy equivalence. Moreover the assignment sending an edge $h$ to the component of $[h]$ induces an isomorphism $hS\cong\pi_0D$, fixing objects and respecting composition. In particular every isomorphism in $\pi_0D$ is represented by an equivalence edge of $S$. No local Kan hypothesis on $D$ is imposed.
